name: Batch Create Directories
description: Create multiple directories in one run with preview support.
author: AntHill Example

parameters.name: directories
parameters.description: Directories to create, one path per line.
parameters.label: Directory List

parameters.name: exist_ok
parameters.description: If enabled, existing directories are treated as success.
parameters.label: Allow Existing Directories

parameters.name: create_parents
parameters.description: If enabled, missing parent directories are created automatically.
parameters.label: Create Parent Directories

parameters.name: allow_absolute_paths
parameters.description: If enabled, absolute paths in the list are allowed.
parameters.label: Allow Absolute Paths
